This Hanoi hotel lies in Cau Giay with plenty of options for eating out, not far from such cultural sights as the Hanoi Museum. You'll be around a 15-minute drive from the Temple of Literature and around a 10-minute drive from the public Vietnam Museum of Ethnology. Sports fans will also enjoy visiting My Dinh Stadium, 2.4 km from the Spring Hotel Hanoi. Guests will also appreciate the vicinity to iph, located nearly a 15-minute walk away. Staying at the hotel, family travellers have access to the Thống Nhất Park, which is 2.3 km away. Doi dien Truong THCS Cau Giay bus stop, offering a direct link to the city attractions and main places, is in close proximity to the Spring Hotel. The rooms overlook the city and feature wireless internet and an LCD TV along with a minibar. These air-conditioned rooms also include blackout curtains and climate control for guests' comfort. Providing a sink, some bathrooms have dressing gowns and shower caps. Every morning of your stay at Spring Hotel Hanoi you will be treated with a free buffet breakfast. The accommodation offers an à la carte restaurant as well as a lounge bar. The restaurant serves Vietnamese cuisine for lunch and dinner.
